prompt:
Task: faithful HD remaster of ONE whole production sprite from the 1993 adventure game Sam & Max Hit the Road. Use the first image as the exact edit target. It contains one complete white SWAN-SHAPED AMUSEMENT RIDE BOAT HULL, side view, facing right, enlarged from the game. This is a rigid painted ride prop, with an open seating space above the long straight low upper rim. The existing job catalog calls this costume Sam and Max together, but that generic description is wrong for this layer: the people are separate moving artwork drawn by the game above this boat. Draw only the complete boat artwork visible in image one. The supplied Sam and Max master sheets, images two and three, are approved LINE, EDGE and FLAT-SHADE STYLE references only; do not add their characters to this empty boat layer.

Preserve the first image's exact side-view silhouette, geometry, proportions, palette, pose and facing direction. The low white hull is broad and rounded along the bottom; the tall pointed feather-shaped stern rises at the left. The swan neck curves down at the right into a small downward black bill and small dark eye. Preserve the gray feather lines inside the raised left stern, the gray inner edge and low seating rim, the gray grooved band around the lower neck, and all the few small gray scuffs and tiny warm tan head marks at their source positions. Keep the cavity and the curved gap beneath the head transparent exactly as in the reference shape. Do not turn the hull into a living swan or add anatomical wings, feet, passengers, seats, fittings, ropes, water or a shadow. No changes to the body length or neck/head size; no perspective change, ornament, expression, new pattern or text.

Clean hand-drawn comic linework and gently antialiased edges, matching the approved game art. Keep the mostly white painted fill and restrained cool-gray contours and existing shade areas. One flat shadow tone, sparse highlights only where implied by the original. No dithering, no pixel stair steps, no grain, no texture, no 3D rendering, no photorealism, no glow or vignette.

Output one PNG on a truly transparent background, exactly 1536 x 1024. One boat only, centered in exactly the first image's location, approximately 1032 x 488 visible pixels at x252 y268. That reference is 8x viewing size; the production pipeline will place the entire own-alpha painting uniformly at the game's fixed 4x size. Do not crop, divide, complete or redesign the boat. No labels, borders or sheet grid. Preserve real transparent alpha in all empty areas.
